notes.title: deadHex Now on Steam Playtest!
notes.content:
[h2]PLAYTEST SCHEDULE - US-WEST (All Times PST):[/h2][p]Friday - Sunday 7PM - 11PM[/p][p]One rotating weekday 7PM - 11PM (Announced on our Discord and game client every week).[/p][p]Grab a friend, queue up, and face off in 1v1 tactical FPS-MOBA combat.[/p][p][/p][h2]WHAT'S NEW THIS BUILD[/h2][list][*][p][b]New map: [/b]Ballroom, a vertical battlefield that promotes intense duels and is perfect for mind games.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Blitz Game Mode: [/b]Our new game mode that has shorter rounds, faster power spikes, and a curated list of Artifacts that show what deadHex is about.  Perfect for newcomers and veterans alike![/p][/*][*][p][b]Balance + Bugfixes: [/b]Improved game flow, expanded build expression, and a ton of under-the-hood polish.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]HELP SHAPE THE DEADHEX[/h2][p]deadHex is still in development, and your input shapes what comes next.  Found a bug?  A build you think is broken?  A moment that felt incredible?  We'd love to know!  Your feedback is invaluable to making deadHex the best game it can be.  [/p][p][/p][h2]WHAT'S NEXT?[/h2][p]If all goes well, we'll be expanding our server up time and regions.  We're looking towards your feedback to incorporate things like a tutorial, spectator system, and replay system.  Until then, we hope you’ll help us test, tune, and shape the future of deadHex.

Thanks for playing.  We’ll see you in the Hamlet.[/p]

notes.title: Demo servers close TONIGHT @ 11:59P.M. PST
notes.content:
We have been overwhelmed by the amount of support we've received over the past two weeks.

A heartfelt thank you to everyone who participated and shared their valuable feedback.

We are eager to dive back into development, using your insights to elevate deadHex.

And if you missed out this time around, don't worry -- we'll be back.

Thanks again,
Electrum Labs

notes.title: Demo is live!
notes.content:
We’re having a 10 day demo on Steam, from October 13th to October 22nd. This means that if you are reading this post, we’d love for you to demo our game on Steam. Given the projected volume, we strongly recommend that you bring a friend.

Now, there will be bugs. Probably a lot of them. There may also be things you feel are inherently unfun and/or unbalanced, and that’s okay! Your input is crucial to shaping the game we all want to play.

Can't make it this time? Don't worry, more demos are on the horizon. If all goes well, we'll aim for Steam's next festival and, perhaps, an early access release. Our ultimate goal is to create a fun, competitive, and free-to-play game.

We hope you have fun playing DeadHex.
